cohort: 120,235 women presenting for obstetric or postpartum care
finding: Expanding pharmacologic prophylactic coverage to include an antepartum admission of >72 hours and those with Age+BMI+CS would result in about a one-third reduction in total VTE events with about 2% requiring treatment.
mod_finding: The combination of cesarean delivery (CS) with age and BMI ≥ 35 (Age+BMI+CS) was noted in 17.3% of postpartum VTE cases.
